card.name: Start of names like Belfast, AKYNZEO
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rare proper name split into parts, such as Bel in Belmullet, Beltsville or Belfast, and YN in the brand name AKYNZEO. It also fires on a few other word starts like sn in snaffle or EN in RENAMO.
